headline: Welspun Corp Drops 8.7% Following Q2 Revenue Miss
summary: Welspun Corp shares fell 8.7% after the company reported second-quarter revenue that missed market estimates.
why: Welspun Corp is a prominent global steel pipe manufacturer supporting oil, gas, and water infrastructure projects.

impacts.name: Welspun Corp
impacts.why: Quarterly top-line earnings missing consensus estimates drove immediate share price decline.
